specs.anchorText: a model and its preprocessing are one object; load them from the same source, never from memory
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: two cartoon puzzle pieces that clearly belong together, one shaped like a friendly robot brain (the pretrained model) and the other shaped like a small funnel or lens stamped with tiny normalization marks (the preprocessing transform), snapping together perfectly and glowing with a happy spark. Beside them, gently faded and slightly comedic, a mismatched funnel from a different set is being forced toward the robot and clearly does not fit, with a small puff of confusion. The style should be friendly and approachable, like an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive but minimal, on a clean light background with generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. The gentle humor is the wrong-shaped piece refusing to fit. Keep the composition focused on one clear visual metaphor: model and preprocessing are two halves of one object.
specs.alt: Two interlocking cartoon puzzle pieces, a robot-brain model and a lens-shaped preprocessing transform, snapping together perfectly while a mismatched transform from another set fails to fit, illustrating that a pretrained model and its normalization must come from the same source.
specs.caption: The preprocessing belongs to the model the way a key belongs to a lock; remember the constants from a blog post instead and accuracy quietly collapses with no error in sight.

specs.anchorText: The naming convention scales linearly with panic and inversely with reproducibility

The style should be friendly and approachable, like an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive but uncluttered, clean light background with generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image, convey sameness through identical folder shapes rather than words. The gentle humor is the indistinguishable pile of duplicate save files. Keep the composition focused on one clear visual metaphor: untracked runs become an unrecoverable heap.
specs.alt: A frazzled researcher buried under a tower of identical-looking save folders, unable to tell which run was the good one, while a calm tracker robot beside them holds a single neat ledger with a checkmark, illustrating how skipping experiment tracking turns a project into an unrecoverable pile of cryptically duplicated checkpoints.
specs.caption: Skip the two lines of run logging and you inherit the folder of indistinguishable checkpoints; an experiment tracker is the tidy ledger that remembers what your GPU-hours discovered.

specs.alt: A four-legged table balancing a trophy-like result, each leg a different color topped with an icon for model, config, data, and run, beside a tilting version of the same table dropping its trophy when one leg is removed, illustrating that a reproducible deep vision result needs all four records together.
